metadata.description: Plugins the agent hub puts on virtual agents: slides, m365 and m365-files on every one, and the others for people who tick them. Anyone can also install them into Claude Code beside a cft-workspace checkout.

plugins.name: welsh
plugins.description: Welsh translations for any CFT service, with no machine translation: catalogue search, missing-Welsh scans, Welsh Language Unit spreadsheets, PRs and Jira story sections

plugins.name: slides
plugins.description: HMCTS-branded PowerPoint decks from an outline: real slide masters with placeholders, so the deck stays editable and on-brand

plugins.name: m365
plugins.description: The person's own Microsoft 365 through agent-hub: mail, calendar, Teams chats and channels, meeting transcripts and a morning briefing, once they have connected it. Read-only

plugins.name: m365-files
plugins.description: OneDrive and SharePoint files through agent-hub: find, read and attach them, and export documents to the person's OneDrive
